_comment: Recorded mock LLM responses keyed by comment id. Hand-authored to read like a real model's structured output (varied reasoning + calibrated confidence) -- the 'cassette' pattern you'd later use to snapshot REAL Claude outputs for regression tests. The mock's apparent intelligence is illustrative of what an LLM returns -- it is not the product. The honest rules-only comparison is the keyword baseline. Keys 101-129 cover comments.json; c001-c015 cover data/sample_comments.json.
